title: Ollaya – Ollama for open-source, Jev-style decision models
summary: Ollaya is a project that brings Ollama-style local model serving to open-source, Jevons-style decision models, letting users run and interact with decision-making AI locally. The Hacker News discussion (484 points, 122 comments) covers its design, use cases, and how it compares to existing local inference tools.
